title: 第17章 一战成名第18章 毒计
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;辰家一脉的开脉大典，就在这跌宕起伏的震撼之中落下了帷幕。
各脉的代表，在离开紫阳峰时，脸上的震撼与惊叹，都未曾消去。
在他们看来，这一次在紫阳峰上的见闻，简直震撼了他们的心灵。
原本他们只是看在紫薇圣主的面子上，才来参加大典。
对于辰南和没落的辰家一脉，他们根本没有放在眼里。
毕竟辰南身怀废体，是出了名的废物。
而辰家一脉自从失去了天辰圣人，便一落千丈，再无当初的辉煌。
然而这一次的大典，却是让他们大开眼界。
不仅药长老亲临镇场，更有圣主赐下上品灵矿一座。
当然，最令人震撼的，还是辰南与萧天麟的赌战。
身怀麒麟圣体的萧天麟，无论是身份背景，还是天赋实力，都是年轻一代的佼佼者。
辰南与他相比，简直是癞蛤蟆与天鹅。
然而这场赌战，却是出乎了所有人的意料。
辰南只用了一爪，便击败了萧天麟，震撼全场。
最终萧天麟不仅当众受辱，还输掉一座上品药田，成为了本年度最大的笑柄。
而辰南则是一战成名，名动整个圣地。
“你们听说了吗？辰南的荒古圣体竟然能够修炼了，不仅达到了轮海境一重，更是当众击败了天麟圣子！”
“不是说荒古圣体天降枷锁，无法修炼吗？这是怎么回事！”
“我听说，是紫薇圣主出手，付出了巨大的代价，才帮辰南解开了一道枷锁。”
“荒古圣体共有十道枷锁，只解开一道根本无济于事，天麟圣子这一次落败受辱，定然不会善罢甘休。”
“辰南太年轻了，年少轻狂，他这一次是出了风头，但以后有他的苦头吃，不说别的，便是诸脉演武这一关，他恐怕都过不了。”
“辰家一脉想要重新崛起基本上是不可能的，不过萧天麟这一次倒是沦为了笑柄！”
圣地各脉，议论纷纷。
所有人都为辰南的一鸣惊人所惊叹。
但也仅此而已。
荒古圣体是出了名的废体，即便解开一道枷锁，成就也十分有限。
而且越到后面，枷锁解开越难。
即便紫薇圣主押上整个圣地，恐怕也无法解开全部枷锁。
因此众人都认为辰南得志猖狂，蹦跶不了多久。
萧家一脉。
天地峰。
此时萧天麟跪在父亲面前，低头认错。

read2();The Chen family's pulse opening ceremony came to an end amidst the ups and downs of shock.
The shock and amazement on the faces of the representatives of each vein have not faded away when they left Ziyang Peak.
In their opinion, what they saw on Ziyang Peak this time simply shocked their souls.
Originally, they only came to attend the ceremony for the sake of Holy Lord Ziwei.
They didn't pay attention to Chen Nan and the declining Chen family at all.
After all, Chen Nan was pregnant with a useless body and was known as a waste.
Since the Chen family lost Saint Tianchen, it has plummeted and has never been as glorious as before.
However, this time the ceremony was an eye-opener for them.
Not only did Elder Yao come to the town in person, but the Holy Lord also gave him a high-grade spiritual mine.
Of course, the most shocking thing is the gambling battle between Chen Nan and Xiao Tianlin.
Xiao Tianlin, who possesses the Qilin Holy Body, is a leader of the younger generation in terms of status, background, and talent.
Compared with him, Chen Nan was like a toad and a swan.
However, this gambling battle exceeded everyone's expectations.
Chen Nan defeated Xiao Tianlin with just one claw, shocking the audience.
In the end, Xiao Tianlin was not only humiliated in public, but also lost a high-grade medicine field, becoming the biggest laughing stock of the year.
Chen Nan, on the other hand, became famous in one battle and became famous throughout the Holy Land.
"Did you hear about it? Chen Nan's ancient holy body was actually able to practice. Not only did he reach the first level of the Wheel Sea Realm, but he also defeated the Holy Son of Tianlin in public!"
"Didn't it say that the ancient holy body was shackles from the sky, making it impossible to practice? What's going on!"
"I heard that it was Holy Lord Ziwei who took action and paid a huge price to help Chen Nan untie the shackles."
"There are ten shackles in the ancient holy body. Unlocking just one will not help at all. Holy Son Tianlin will definitely not give up after being defeated and humiliated this time."
"Chen Nan is too young and frivolous. He is in the limelight this time, but he will suffer in the future. If nothing else, he may not be able to pass the Zhumai martial arts test."
"It is basically impossible for the Chen family to rise again, but Xiao Tianlin has become a laughing stock this time!"
There was a lot of discussion in various branches of the Holy Land.
Everyone was amazed by Chen Nan's sudden success.
But that's all.
The ancient holy body is notoriously useless. Even if one of its shackles is released, its achievements will be very limited.
And the further you get to the back, the harder it is to untie the shackles.
Even if Holy Lord Ziwei takes the entire Holy Land, he may not be able to release all the shackles.
Therefore, everyone thought that Chen Nan was extremely ambitious and would not be able to survive for long.
A lineage of the Xiao family.
Heaven and Earth Peak.
At this time, Xiao Tianlin knelt in front of his father, bowed his head and admitted his mistake.
